definitions.gloss: bulk buying; buying in quantity; purchasing multiple items at once
definitions.explanation: the practice of buying many items or large quantities at one time, often to save money or time

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}にまとめ{買|が}いをする。
examples.english: I do bulk shopping on weekends.

examples.japanese: {日用品|にちようひん}はまとめ{買|が}いした{方|ほう}がお{得|とく}だ。
examples.english: It's more economical to buy daily necessities in bulk.

examples.japanese: セールでまとめ{買|が}いしすぎた。
examples.english: I bought too much stuff at the sale.

notes:
Compound of まとめ (combining, from まとめる) + {買|か}い (buying, with rendaku → がい). Refers to purchasing many items or large quantities at once.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- まとめ{買|が}いをする: to buy in bulk
- まとめ{買|が}いで{安|やす}くなる: to get cheaper by buying in bulk
- まとめ{買|が}いする: to bulk-buy (suru verb usage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {買|か}いだめ: stocking up, hoarding (implies storing for future use)
- {大量|たいりょう}{購入|こうにゅう}: large-quantity purchase (more formal)
- ついで{買|が}い: impulse add-on purchase
- {衝動|しょうどう}{買|が}い: impulse buying

CULTURAL NOTE:
With the popularity of コストコ (Costco) and online shopping, まとめ{買|が}い has become increasingly common in Japan. Supermarkets also offer まとめ{買|が}い discounts.
